description: Voxel style-test diorama on an exhibit plinth: two faceted detector rings threaded on a beam pipe, a glowing cyan signature particle with a tapered trail, a blue data block, and a sign. Establishes the shared low-poly material and lighting language for the portfolio's 3D scenes.

interactiveDescriptions.INT_detector_signature_particle: The signature particle inside the beam pipe. Selecting it starts the journey through the detector scene.
